inline.afterHeadingEn: ## How to Read the Best-Sign Theory in the Data
inline.titleEn: How to Check the Best-Sign Theory Yourself
inline.titleZh: 如何自行验证最佳星座理论
inline.altEn: Five steps for checking the best soccer players zodiac sign theory against birth-month data
inline.altZh: 验证最佳足球运动员星座理论的五个步骤

items.subEn: Locate the youth selection cutoff for the league or country — often January 1 in football
items.subZh: 找到联赛或国家的青少年选拔截止日期，足球中通常为1月1日

items.subEn: Births just after the cutoff are overrepresented among elite players, regardless of sign
items.subZh: 截止日期后不久出生的球员在精英行列中比例偏高，与星座无关

items.nameEn: Translate Months to Signs as Labels Only
items.nameZh: 将月份转化为标签式星座
items.subEn: Map birth months to zodiac signs only as a label, never as a cause of talent
items.subZh: 将出生月份对应星座仅视为标签，而非天赋的成因

items.subEn: Notice whether the best sign changes when the cutoff changes — which rules out astrology
items.subZh: 观察截止日期改变时最佳星座是否随之变化，这能排除占星因素

items.subEn: Treat any best-zodiac claim as a calendar artifact, not a star-based forecast
items.subZh: 将任何最佳星座主张视为日历效应的产物，而非基于星象的预测

inline.afterHeadingEn: ## the Best-Sign Theory at a Glance
inline.altEn: Comparison of Relative Age Effect, Cutoff Dependence, and Zodiac as Label in soccer birth-month data
inline.altZh: 足球出生月份数据中相对年龄效应、截止日期依赖与星座标签的对比

linesEn: Births just after the age-group cutoff
More elite players born early in the selection year
linesZh: 同队列中年龄较大的孩子更易被选中
出生在年龄组截止日期后不久
精英球员中更多人出生于选拔年度初期

linesEn: Lucky months shift with the cutoff date
Favored months move when a country changes its rule
linesZh: 幸运月份随截止日期变动
截止日期之后的任何季度
国家更改规则时受青睐的月份也随之改变

linesEn: Maps a birth month onto a sign, not a cause
The sign covering the overrepresented months
A sign looks lucky only because of the calendar
linesZh: 将出生月份映射为星座，而非因果关系
覆盖过度代表月份的星座
星座看起来幸运仅因为日历效应
